question: On Qwen3.6-27B's no-CoT single-table brew errors that are off the true cycle, is the wrong intermediate w = T^-1(answer) readable before the answer exists (read), and can additive edits of matched size swap a key on correct items or repair an error (write)?

model.name: Qwen3.6-27B
model.rendering: exp10 C0: one h=2 shot, thinking off, 'Answer:' prefilled
model.layer_convention: layer l = output of decoder block l = hidden_states[l + 1]
model.kernels: flash-linear-attention 0.5.2; cuDNN SDPA disabled; causal_conv1d absent (torch path)

items.dev_bank: exp11 single_test (250 per h, seen in exp11)
items.groups: correct | offcycle (answer != T^k(s0) for k in 0..h+3) | miscount (unique k) | miscount_ambiguous
items.controls: all colours minus (true path, implied path, T(answer))

token_lenses.score: readout logits (template: cosine) over the 10 colours

readers.probe: exp11_probe features + fit (PCA-64, multinomial LR, wd 1e-2), 5-fold cross-fit
readers.diffmeans: mean(x | key=c) - mean(x | key!=c), same folds
readers.ao_prompt:
An activation vector from layer {layer} of a language model is enclosed in activation tags:
<activation>{char}</activation>. Produce distinct concepts that encode this activation, each as
a '- ' bullet on its own line.

tests.P1: correct items, per h in {2, 3}: AUC of S(key = s_{h-1}) vs controls

secondary: answer-leak filtered AUC (pairs where J++ ranks the answer outside its top 3)
hypothesis decomposition: top among {w, true s_{h-1}, controls}
strata: gold is / is not the runner-up colour; h = 2 / 3; gates 0.0 / 0.5 / 0.8
AUC of the true s_{h-1} vs controls

P3.edit: c = s1 -> c' = s1' (s1', T(s1'), T(T(s1')) off the true path and distinct)
P3.outcomes: success T(s1') | start_swap T(T(s1')) | echo s1' | unchanged | other

variants.answer_swap: c = s2 -> c' = a' (ceiling and gate: success >= 0.30 on dev)
variants.random_null: seeded random unit direction, same alpha and layer
variants.other_item: c, c' = two colours unrelated to the item

P3.primary_metric: per-item key_swap success - random_null success at the locked setting
P3.head_to_head: every method at layer 42, at its best dev alpha there

P4.edit: c = w -> c' = true s2; success = gold
controls: redirect: c' = r off both paths, success = T(r)
P4.eligibility: methods with dev key_swap success - null >= 0.10 that pass the gate

writes.edit: h_p += alpha ||h_p|| unit(v_l(c') - v_l(c)) at block-l output, positions start colour token .. final token

directions.diffmeans: dev correct h=2/3 items, final cell, key classes

templates: Colour-change puzzle about a potion: tracking the current colour through the stir rules. The potion is {c} right now, and the model is about to apply the rule for a {c} potion.
Rule lookup in progress: the relevant line is 'A {c} potion turns ...'; the answer is the colour that {c} turns into.
The intermediate colour before the last stir is {c}; the final answer follows from the {c} rule.
Answer slot after 'Answer:' in a short puzzle; the colour held in mind is {c}, about to be mapped through the table once more.
After that stir the potion is {c}
Before the last stir it was {c}

writes.selection_rule: per method, on dev: the (layer, alpha) maximising key_swap success - random_null success; ties -> smaller alpha, then earlier layer. Gate: the method's best answer_swap success over its grid >= 0.30, else 'cannot write at this edit size' (K3).

statistics.multiplicity: Holm over readers x {P1 h=2, P1 h=3, P2 AUC, P2 direction}

kill_rules.K1: no reader reads the on-path key on dev -> exploratory sweep, then count target
kill_rules.K2: < 100 projected consistent off-cycle test errors -> enlarge h=3 bank (applied)
kill_rules.K3: answer_swap gate failed -> 'cannot write at this edit size'
kill_rules.K4: no method reaches dev key_swap - null >= 0.10 -> repair reported untestable

deviations_from_plan: Consistency gate: p(a') >= 0.3 is primary (plan: 0.5, sensitivity 0.8). At 0.5 dev kept 3 of 52 h=3 off-cycle errors; 0.0, 0.5 and 0.8 are reported as sensitivity (0.8 is expected to be empty: no dev off-cycle error reaches it).
Test bank enlarged to 100 / 600 / 2000 items at h = 1 / 2 / 3 (plan: 100 / 300 / 1000), per K2: dev projects 26 + 136 consistent off-cycle errors at the 0.3 gate.
Primary read cells chosen on dev: question_end, nl_asst (the newline after 'assistant'), final. think_close was a candidate; its reads were at chance on dev.
transformers stores hidden_states[64] after the final norm, so lenses read layers 0..62 (as planned) and no reader sees the raw block-63 output.
J++ (koayon/jpp-lenses) ships one Jacobian per layer, so the plan's 'expert mixture evaluated at the clean h' does not apply; its single matrix is used for reads and writes.
Lens write directions include the final norm's gain g: v = J_l^T (g * W_U[c]) (logit lens: g * W_U[c]); exp14 used W_U[c] J without g.

agu18dec's pooled whitener is gated. Our own (natural-text passages, WHITENER_SPEC) stands in: ptag AR retrieval is scored in our whitened space, and ptag AR write directions are mapped back with our S^1/2.
AO prompt: both renderings of the README's concepts_raw prompt were scored in day-0 check 6 and the README's line-break rendering was kept.
Day-0 check 6 used the next 20 tokens (the template-lens passages are about 45 tokens long), not 32.

Day-0 check 4 (lens sanity) fails its literal bar (>= 0.90 top-1 at L60; observed 0.76 to 0.86). On items where the model's colour softmax is confident (p >= 0.8) every lens is >= 0.99; misses concentrate on h=3 items with p < 0.8, where the last block often flips the top colour. The lenses are kept as readers; their reads on uncertain items are noisier, which is reported.
Text readers on test run on all off-cycle errors plus seeded subsamples of 300 correct items per h (P1) and 300 miscounts (secondary), to bound generation cost.
The probe and diffmeans are trained on correct h=2 and h=3 items pooled (target: the key, s_{h-1}); other rows are scored by the mean of the five fold models.
P2 pools h=2 and h=3 off-cycle errors (strata by h are reported); P4 uses h=3 only, as planned.
Reader scores: rank-average within (cell, layer) pairs for continuous readers; mean naming fraction for text readers (the plan's 'fraction of samples naming c').
The prompt-only analytic baseline gives AUC(w) = 0.5 by construction (w is never on the true path of an off-cycle error); the thinking-on baseline runs with the self-report secondary.
Write settings are frozen in a separate write_lock.json (after the dev grid, before any test write trial), so the locked manifest is never edited.
confounds: answer leak: a reader naming w because the answer's rule line is active (direction test, J++ leak filter)
path co-activation: the probe at h=3 mixes s1 and s2 on correct items
edit size: alpha * ||h|| matched across methods; random and other-item nulls
text readers: colour words in readouts can come from the prompt's rule list (controls are colours in the same rule list)
